## Author checklist  (the author ticks these BEFORE requesting review)
- [ ] My branch is up to date with `main` and the CI checks are green
- [ ] I touched only files in my own area (or the owner of the other area agreed in the issue)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `make test` passes locally
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, raw survey data, or photos of people committed
- [ ] New data rows carry `source`, `fetched_at`, `confidence`; anything simulated is labelled `synthetic`
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] Screenshot or short recording attached (UI or visible behaviour)
- [ ] I can explain every line of this PR, including AI-generated code

## Reviewer checklist  (the reviewer ticks these AFTER running the branch)
- [ ] I checked out the branch and ran it, not just read the diff
- [ ] The PR does what the issue says, nothing more
- [ ] Tests test behaviour (not trivially passing)
- [ ] I asked the author to explain one function and they could
- [ ] No hard-coded paths, keys or oversized files
